subject: expression: avoid refinement of arguments on nullable value (#55805)
summary: Changes `compareFunctionClass.refineArgsByUnsignedFlag` to only refine `=` comparisons when the column is `NOT NULL`, preserving NULL (3-valued) semantics for nullable results (e.g. aggregates/subquery outputs), while keeping `<=>` refinement intact. Adds unit + integration regression coverage for #44706; no plausible Blocker/High issues found.
